name: Fishin' Time
summary: At Stormwind harbor, Gilbert Gray keeps to his fishing line while the fish are biting. His supplies run low, so he asks passersby to fetch nightcrawlers and a shiny bauble from a shop along the city canals.

sections.title: A Day by the Water
sections.body: Gilbert Gray watches his bobber dance on the water. The elderly angler will not leave his prized perch while the fish are biting. His supplies have run out, and he needs help so he can stay at his line instead of returning to the city.

sections.title: Supplies Along the Canals
sections.body: Catherine Leland runs a tackle shop beside Stormwind's stone canals, just west of the Trade District. Fishermen across the city come to her for lures and bait. Her shop can replenish what Gilbert Gray needs to keep fishing.

faq.answer: Gilbert Gray is an elderly fisherman at Stormwind harbor. He spends his days casting into the sea and asks passersby to fetch bait and lures when his supplies run low.
Catherine Leland runs a fishing supply shop along the city canals, just west of the Trade District. She sells fishing equipment and bait to Stormwind's anglers.
Gilbert Gray fishes at Stormwind harbor, where he enjoys the open view of the sea.

faq.q: What supplies does Gilbert Gray need?
faq.answer: Gilbert Gray needs nightcrawlers for bait and a shiny bauble for a lure. Catherine Leland sells both along the canals.

faq.q: Why doesn't Gilbert Gray fetch the supplies himself?
faq.answer: The fish are biting, and Gilbert Gray does not want to leave his spot or miss a good catch by going back into the city for supplies.

faq.q: Where along the canals is Catherine Leland's shop located?
faq.answer: Catherine Leland's shop is along the canals just west of the Trade District, beside the stone walkways over the city's waterways.

angles.text: As an Alliance citizen, helping Gilbert Gray with an everyday need supports life and morale across Stormwind.
As a human who calls Stormwind home, helping an elder enjoy a quiet afternoon of fishing offers a break from kingdom politics.
